items.heading: Cuet Cuet Cuet Cuet
items.text: Cuet Cuet Cuet CUET-UG (Common University Entrance Test) is a national exam run by the National Testing Agency. It started as the admission route for central universities and has since been adopted by a large and growing list of state and private universities as well.

items.heading: Bsc Nursing At Most Institutes
items.text: Bsc Nursing At Most Institutes BSc Nursing at most institutes. Outside the specific universities that use CUET for nursing, most nursing colleges run their own entrance test or state-level nursing CET. Do not assume a CUET score works at a nursing college you have not individually checked.

rows: The most direct CUET route for a biology-stream student. Requires Chemistry plus Physics plus one of Biology, Biological Studies, Biotechnology, or Biochemistry as domain subjects at most universities, including many Delhi University colleges.
Runs on a similar domain-subject combination to Life Sciences. Offered by several central and state universities that participate in CUET-UG for their science programs.

Some universities admit BSc Nursing through CUET domain scores, but many nursing programs still run their own separate entrance test. Check each target college individually rather than assuming CUET covers nursing everywhere.

A subset of state agricultural universities accept CUET scores for BSc Agriculture and allied programs, while many others still use the separate ICAR AIEEA exam. Confirm which entrance route your target agricultural university actually uses this year.

items.heading: Mbbs, Bds, and Ayush Courses
items.text: MBBS, BDS, and AYUSH courses. These stay NEET-only across India. CUET has no role in medical, dental, or AYUSH admission at any stage, regardless of your domain-subject choice.

items.heading: Icar
items.text: ICAR-affiliated agricultural universities. Most agricultural universities under the Indian Council of Agricultural Research use the ICAR AIEEA exam, not CUET, for BSc Agriculture admission. A handful of state agricultural universities do participate in CUET, so this needs a college-by-college check, not a blanket assumption either way.

items.heading: A Guaranteed Seat At Any
items.text: A guaranteed seat at any specific university. CUET gives you a percentile-based score, not an admission. Each participating university runs its own separate counselling and cutoff process on top of the CUET result.

items.heading: Cuet Is National and Multi
items.text: CUET is national and multi-university; EAMCET/EAPCET is state-specific to Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

items.heading: Neither Exam Is the Same
items.text: Neither exam is the same as NEET, even though BiPC/PCB students sit a biology-heavy paper for all three.

items.heading: A Cuet Score Is Not
items.text: A CUET score is not one universal cutoff, each participating university reads it differently for its own programs.
